description: This file defines the GrainClassMap class, which provides mapping between GrainType instances and their corresponding implementation Types, supporting type conversions and generic type handling within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: GrainClassMap
classes.description: Provides mapping between GrainType and Type, with support for generic types and type conversion.

methods.name: GrainClassMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing the map with a type converter and a dictionary of GrainType to Type mappings.

methods.name: TryGetGrainClass
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the class Type associated with a given GrainType, handling generic types if necessary.
